events.verdict: Champagnie (SAS) avoids stepping out of bounds after he receives the pass in the corner.
Champagnie (SAS) is moving to align alongside Murray's (DEN) path and marginal body contact occurs as Murray cuts back toward Champagnie after his gather.
Westbrook (DEN) initiates contact across Johnson's (SAS) left arm during the layup attempt.
Porter Jr. (DEN) and Wembanyama (SAS) briefly engage and disengage with one another after they come together off-ball.
Porter Jr.'s (DEN) arms are brought forward when marginal contact occurs with Wembanyama's (SAS) arm as he moves from side-to-side prior to releasing his dribble.

Westbrook (DEN) makes clean contact with the ball and momentarily dislodges it away from Wembanyama (SAS) as Porter Jr. (DEN) simultaneously makes marginal contact with Wembanyama's front. Westbrook then dives toward the loose ball and further marginal body contact occurs with Wembanyama.

Wembanyama (SAS) is established in Jokic's (DEN) path and absorbs the marginal body contact to his  chest as Jokic drives toward him. Wembanyama simultaneously brings his right arm forward toward the ball and further marginal contact occurs with Jokic's front.
Champagnie's (SAS) left foot steps out of bounds after he receives the pass along the sideline. Possession is correctly awarded to Denver.
Wembanyama (SAS) and Johnson (SAS) each maintain a legal guarding position as they double team Jokic (DEN) in the post.
Murray (DEN) legally contests Vassell's (SAS) dunk attempt.
Johnson (SAS) and Vassell (SAS) each avoid making contact with Porter Jr. (DEN) after he starts his upward shooting motion.
